arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made with a card whose type is prepaid debit, so any purchase on those cards is caught regardless of amount, merchant or channel.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit card' is taken to mean card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'. Plain 'Debit' and 'Credit' cards are not included.
